messages:
lee_ops: Alert: ap-southeast-1 warm pool failing to bootstrap after yesterday's keystore trust-policy tighten. Warm pool down to ~60%, lots of `kms:Decrypt` denied in node-agent.

anya_infra: timeline? NAT/GW look ok?

lee_ops: first errors at 02:03 local. node-agent: `error: kms:Decrypt Denied (Principal: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/spot-provisioner)` then retries flood. Also saw `connect: no route` on some attempts.

sam_sre: can you paste a sample log line?

lee_ops: paste: ```
2026-03-22T02:03:12Z node-agent[info] request=keystore decrypt failed err="AccessDenied: Decrypt denied for principal arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/spot-provisioner" req_id=abc-123
```

anya_infra: checking infra metrics: NAT gateway concurrent connections spiked and ephemeral port usage hit 65500/65535 on edge NAT. Looks like retries created port exhaustion.

olivia_security: I pushed the trust-policy change last night to narrow allowed principals to org-managed roles only. It should have excluded some older provisioning roles. I can revert immediately if needed.

sam_sre: immediate mitigation plan: (1) scale NAT (add second natgw), (2) expand ephemeral port range on warmpool nodes, (3) temporary KMS allowance for `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/spot-provisioner` for 4 hours so bootstraps finish, (4) preserve audit trail. Who can apply 3?

olivia_security: I'll create a 4h policy exception now and file SC-800. Policy snippet to apply (temporary): ```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456:role/spot-provisioner"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Condition":{"NumericLessThan":{"kms:RequestTimeEpochSeconds":"1710000000"}}}]}
```

anya_infra: scaled NAT and adjusted node sysctl for net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range to `10240 65535`. Deployed in ap-southeast-1, propagation ~45s.

deploy-bot: infra action: created additional NAT gateway in ap-southeast-1 (nat-0c0ffee) and applied sysctl change to warm-pool autoscale group.

lee_ops: nodes are reattempting bootstrap, seeing fewer AccessDenied now. Warm pool health climbing: 60% -> 83% in 4m.

sam_sre: keep tracing. We need to understand why audit logs show a burst of `Denied` but also a gap in KMS audit entries for ~30s mid-window. Could be proxy queueing + retries collapsing audit events.

olivia_security: I'll review KMS CloudTrail and keystore-proxy logs for denied request ids. Also re-evaluating the rollout process: we should notify eng-sre when restricting principals that affect provisioning.

anya_infra: uploaded tcpdumps + conntrack snapshots to S3: s3://infra-dumps/ap-southeast1/1766667777/conntrack.pcap

lee_ops: warm pool now 95% after 9m. Still want a postmortem and two follow-ups: (A) add a preflight check in keystore-rollouts to query warm-pool provisioning principals, (B) add a synthetic test exercising provisioning under NAT port pressure.

sam_sre: agreed. I'll create the incident ticket and schedule a 1h postmortem. Artifacts in the ticket reference s3 path.

olivia_security: filing SC-800 with rollback record and remediation items: add an allowlist audit step and update change playbook to call out provisioning roles.

deploy-bot: actions closed: temporary KMS exception removed at 4h mark, NAT autoscale kept.

lee_ops: thanks everyone. Quick wins worked. We'll follow up with detailed write-up in /incidents and add runbook steps to keystore runbook for NAT exhaustion scenarios.

sam_sre: thumbs-up. Scheduling postmortem doc and assigning owners for the two follow-ups.
